component.name: AppPicker
component.script:
sub init() m.th = LumenTheme() m.top.visible = false m.cols = 5 m.pitchX = 324 m.pitchY = 262 m.dim = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") m.dim.width = 1920 m.dim.height = 1080 sheet = m.top.createChild("Poster") sheet.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/sheet_r44.9.png" sheet.blendColor = m.th.paper sheet.translation = [60, 40] sheet.width = 1800 sheet.height = 1000 t = m.top.createChild("Label") t.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Title", 56) t.color = m.th.ink t.text = "Choose apps for Home" t.translation = [140, 86] t.width = 1200 t.height = 70 s = m.top.createChild("Label") s.font = LumenFont("Manrope-Bold", 24) s.color = m.th.ink60 s.text = "OK shows or hides an app · Back saves" s.translation = [142, 160] s.width = 1200 s.height = 34 m.window = m.top.createChild("Group") m.window.translation = [0, 236] m.window.clippingRect = [60, -30, 1800, 790] m.grid = m.window.createChild("Group") m.index = 0 m.scrollRow = 0 end sub
sub onDeep() m.dim.color = WithAlpha(m.top.deep, 0.55) end sub
sub onOpen() m.top.visible = m.top.open if m.top.open then build() end sub
sub build() m.grid.removeChildrenIndex(m.grid.getChildCount(), 0) m.items = [] apps = m.top.apps for i = 0 to apps.Count() - 1 col = i mod m.cols row = Int(i / m.cols) g = m.grid.createChild("Group") g.translation = [150 + col * m.pitchX, row * m.pitchY] tile = g.createChild("AppTile") tile.iconBase = m.top.iconBase tile.app = apps[i] name = g.createChild("Label") name.font = LumenFont("Manrope-Bold", 24) name.color = m.th.ink name.horizAlign = "center" name.text = apps[i].name name.translation = [0, 204] name.width = 288 name.height = 34 badge = g.createChild("Group") badge.translation = [244, -12] disc = badge.createChild("Poster") disc.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" disc.blendColor = m.th.ink disc.width = 52 disc.height = 52 check = badge.createChild("Poster") check.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/ic_check.png" check.translation = [10, 10] check.width = 32 check.height = 32 m.items.Push({ tile: tile, badge: badge, id: apps[i].id }) end for m.index = 0 m.scrollRow = 0 paint() end sub
sub paint() hidden = m.top.hidden for i = 0 to m.items.Count() - 1 it = m.items[i] it.tile.focused = (i = m.index) it.badge.visible = (hidden[it.id] = invalid) if hidden[it.id] = invalid then it.tile.opacity = 1 else it.tile.opacity = 0.45 end for ' Keep the focused row inside the three visible rows. row = Int(m.index / m.cols) if row > m.scrollRow + 2 then m.scrollRow = row - 2 if row < m.scrollRow then m.scrollRow = row m.grid.translation = [0, -m.scrollRow * m.pitchY] end sub
function handleKey(key as string) as boolean n = m.items.Count() if n = 0 then return true i = m.index if key = "left" and i mod m.cols > 0 then i = i - 1 if key = "right" and i mod m.cols < m.cols - 1 and i + 1 < n then i = i + 1 if key = "up" and i - m.cols >= 0 then i = i - m.cols if key = "down" and i + m.cols < n then i = i + m.cols if key = "OK" h = m.top.hidden id = m.items[i].id if h[id] = invalid then h[id] = true else h.Delete(id) m.top.hidden = h end if m.index = i paint() return true end function
